best_opportunities.core_hypothesis: The non-obvious edge is not simply higher copper prices; it is the combination of strong sales growth, volume-led expansion, copper-price sensitivity, and leadership in a broad market risk-on regime.
confirmation: monthly sales keeps setting higher highs
price advances with improving turnover rather than only gap-up behavior
invalidation: sales growth rolls over for two consecutive releases
volume falls while revenue is supported only by price
copper price breaks down materially and remains weak
stock leadership disappears while market breadth remains healthy
best_opportunities.strategy: Scale in only on confirmed support/accumulation; avoid chasing an extended green candle. Increase exposure after a high-volume close above confirmation.

if_i_were_the_investor.1_would_you_buy_now_or_wait: Wait for confirmation - scale in only on confirmed support/accumulation around 19,400-20,000 rial zone. Avoid chasing extended green candles.
if_i_were_the_investor.2_if_already_holding_hold_reduce_or_sell: Hold if already positioned with entry near 19,400-20,000 rial. Reduce if volume deteriorates while price advances. Sell if 18,800 risk line breaks on expanding volume.
if_i_were_the_investor.3_which_industry_gets_priority: Technology/AI - strongest factor coverage across 40 factors, persistent leadership in risk-on regimes.
if_i_were_the_investor.4_which_industry_should_be_avoided_for_n: Sectors with deteriorating real-money flow and volume without price support - validate with fundamental data first.
if_i_were_the_investor.5_best_opportunity: فملی (FMLI) - operating leverage + volume-led expansion + copper price sensitivity + broad market leadership.
if_i_were_the_investor.6_most_dangerous_setup: chasing FMLI extended green candles without volume confirmation or real-money flow support.
if_i_were_the_investor.7_single_event_would_reverse_the_view: FMLI breaking below 18,800 rial on expanding volume with real-money outflow acceleration, or copper breaking down materially and remaining weak.

safety_integrity.decision_support_not_certainty: This is decision support, not certainty. Never guarantee returns. Never fabricate missing observations. Prefer NO TRADE / WAIT when evidence or risk/reward is inadequate.
safety_integrity.objective: Preserve capital → detect regime → detect liquidity rotation → identify edge → enter with controlled risk → manage position → exit by evidence → learn from outcome.
